test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Item Master and Inventory Tracking
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can accurately track raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods using the standard item master.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured as per Installation Qualification.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A set of standard item masters for raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods are pre-loaded or can be created.

test_steps.action: Create a new item master record for a raw material, specifying its details.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully creates and saves the item master record.

test_steps.action: Create a new item master record for a packaging component, specifying its details.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully creates and saves the item master record.

test_steps.action: Create a new item master record for a finished good, specifying its details.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully creates and saves the item master record.

test_steps.action: Perform an inventory receipt transaction for the raw material, entering a quantity.
test_steps.expected_result: The system records the receipt and updates the inventory quantity for the raw material.

test_steps.action: Perform an inventory receipt transaction for the packaging component, entering a quantity.
test_steps.expected_result: The system records the receipt and updates the inventory quantity for the packaging component.

test_steps.action: Perform an inventory receipt transaction for the finished good, entering a quantity.
test_steps.expected_result: The system records the receipt and updates the inventory quantity for the finished good.

acceptance_criteria: All created item master records are stored correctly in the system.
Inventory quantities for all tracked items are accurately updated after receipt transactions.
The system correctly differentiates between raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-002: Track raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods using standard item master.
data_integrity_requirements: Inventory quantities must be accurate and reflect all transactions.
Item master data must be complete and correctly associated with inventory.

test_cases.test_name: Verify FIFO and FEFO Inventory Rotation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system correctly implements First-In-First-Out (FIFO) and First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) inventory rotation logic.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
Multiple batches of the same item with different expiry dates are received into inventory.

test_steps.action: Receive Batch A of Item X with expiry date YYYY-MM-DD.
test_steps.expected_result: Batch A is recorded in inventory with its expiry date.

test_steps.action: Receive Batch B of Item X with an earlier expiry date ZZZZ-MM-DD.
test_steps.expected_result: Batch B is recorded in inventory with its earlier expiry date.

test_steps.action: Perform a picking transaction for Item X, requesting a quantity that would consume both batches.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prioritizes picking from Batch B (earlier expiry date) first, followed by Batch A, demonstrating FEFO.

test_steps.action: Receive Batch C of Item Y with expiry date AAAA-MM-DD.
test_steps.expected_result: Batch C is recorded in inventory with its expiry date.

test_steps.action: Receive Batch D of Item Y with a later receipt date but the same expiry date as Batch C.
test_steps.expected_result: Batch D is recorded in inventory with its expiry date.

test_steps.action: Perform a picking transaction for Item Y, requesting a quantity that would consume both batches.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prioritizes picking from Batch C (earlier receipt date) first, followed by Batch D, demonstrating FIFO.

acceptance_criteria: The system correctly identifies and prioritizes the batch with the earliest expiry date for picking (FEFO).
The system correctly identifies and prioritizes the batch with the earliest receipt date for picking when expiry dates are the same (FIFO).
Inventory quantities are accurately reduced based on the selected batches during picking.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-003: Implement First-In-First-Out (FIFO) inventory rotation using vendor default algorithms.
URS-INV-004: Support First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) rotation for expiry date management.
data_integrity_requirements: Inventory rotation logic must be consistently applied to prevent stock obsolescence and ensure product quality.
Expiry dates and receipt dates must be accurately recorded and utilized by the system.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Real-time Inventory Quantity Updates and Barcode Scanning
test_cases.objective: To verify that inventory quantities are updated in real-time and that barcode scanning functionality is operational.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User has appropriate access privileges.
Barcode scanner is connected and functional.
Test items with known quantities are available.

test_steps.action: Perform a manual inventory adjustment (e.g., add 10 units of Item A) through the system interface.
test_steps.expected_result: The system reflects the addition of 10 units for Item A within 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Scan the barcode of Item B to record its movement (e.g., from receiving to storage).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully recognizes the barcode and updates the inventory location and quantity for Item B.

test_steps.action: Perform a manual inventory adjustment (e.g., remove 5 units of Item A) through the system interface.
test_steps.expected_result: The system reflects the removal of 5 units for Item A within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Inventory quantities are updated accurately and within the specified 30-second timeframe after manual adjustments.
Barcode scanning successfully identifies items and updates their inventory status and location.
All inventory movements are logged correctly.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-006
URS-INV-007
URS-INV-016
data_integrity_requirements: Inventory quantities must be accurate and reflect all transactions.
Audit trail must capture all inventory adjustments and barcode scans.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Cycle Count Scheduling and Inventory Movement Reporting
test_cases.objective: To verify the system's ability to generate cycle count schedules and produce standard inventory movement reports.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User has appropriate access privileges.
Sufficient inventory data exists for reporting.
Cycle count parameters (e.g., frequency, items) are configured.

test_steps.action: Initiate the generation of a cycle count schedule based on predefined parameters.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates a cycle count schedule listing items and locations to be counted.
data_to_capture: Generated cycle count schedule details (items, locations, dates)

test_steps.action: Generate an inventory movement report for a specified period (e.g., last 24 hours).
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an inventory movement report detailing all additions, removals, and transfers within the specified period.
data_to_capture: Details of inventory movements (item, quantity, type of movement, date/time)

test_steps.action: Generate a second inventory movement report for a different period (e.g., last week) to ensure flexibility.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an accurate inventory movement report for the second specified period.
data_to_capture: Details of inventory movements (item, quantity, type of movement, date/time)

acceptance_criteria: Cycle count schedules are generated accurately and include all relevant items and locations.
Inventory movement reports are generated within the specified time (5 minutes) and accurately reflect all inventory transactions for the selected period.
Reports are generated in a standard, readable format.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-008
URS-INV-009
URS-INV-016
URS-INV-018
data_integrity_requirements: Cycle count schedules must be comprehensive and accurate.
Inventory movement reports must accurately reflect all historical transactions.
Audit trail must support the data presented in reports.

test_cases.test_name: Verify User Access Controls and Role-Based Security
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system enforces user access controls and role-based security as per URS-INV-017.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User accounts with different roles (e.g., Administrator, Warehouse Operator, Viewer) are created.
Permissions for each role are defined in the system.

test_steps.action: Log in to the system using an Administrator account.
test_steps.expected_result: Administrator can access all system functionalities and settings.

test_steps.action: Log out and log in using a Warehouse Operator account.
test_steps.expected_result: Warehouse Operator can perform inventory management tasks (e.g., receiving, picking, cycle counts) but cannot access administrative settings or user management.

test_steps.action: Log out and log in using a Viewer account.
test_steps.expected_result: Viewer can only view inventory data and reports, with no ability to modify any data or access system settings.

test_steps.action: Attempt to perform an action restricted to a higher privilege role (e.g., Warehouse Operator attempting to change user roles).
test_steps.expected_result: The system prevents the action and displays an appropriate error message indicating insufficient privileges.

acceptance_criteria: All user roles correctly restrict access to functionalities as defined.
Users can only perform actions permitted by their assigned role.
Attempting unauthorized actions results in appropriate error messages and prevention of the action.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-017: Support user access controls through vendor's role-based security.
data_integrity_requirements: User access controls must prevent unauthorized data modification.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Generation and Data Export
test_cases.objective: To verify that standard inventory reports can be generated within the specified time and that data can be exported to Excel format accurately.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
Sufficient inventory data exists in the system to generate meaningful reports.
Excel is installed on the testing workstation.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard inventory movement report using a pre-built template.
test_steps.expected_result: The report generates successfully within 5 minutes and accurately reflects the inventory movements.

test_steps.action: Generate an inventory accuracy report using standard reconciliation features.
test_steps.expected_result: The report generates successfully and accurately identifies any discrepancies.

test_steps.action: Export the generated inventory movement report to Excel format.
test_steps.expected_result: The data is exported successfully to an Excel file.

test_steps.action: Open the exported Excel file and compare a sample of the data with the report displayed in the system.
test_steps.expected_result: The data in the Excel file matches the data in the system report exactly.
data_to_capture: Any discrepancies between system report and Excel export

test_steps.action: Verify that transaction history can be archived using vendor's data retention policies.
test_steps.expected_result: The system provides functionality to archive historical transaction data according to configured retention policies.

acceptance_criteria: Standard reports generate within the specified 5-minute timeframe.
Generated reports are accurate and reflect the system's data.
Data exported to Excel is complete and matches the system report.
Transaction history archiving functionality is available and operational.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-009: Create inventory movement reports using pre-built templates.
URS-INV-018: Generate inventory accuracy reports using standard reconciliation features.
URS-INV-019: Archive transaction history using vendor's data retention policies.
URS-INV-021: Export inventory data to Excel format using built-in export functionality.
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must be accurate and complete.
Excel export must maintain data integrity.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Multiple Storage Locations and Reorder Alerts
test_cases.objective: To verify the system's ability to manage inventory across multiple storage locations and generate timely reorder alerts based on defined minimum stock levels.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User has administrative privileges.
At least two distinct storage locations are configured.
Several items are configured with minimum stock levels.

test_steps.action: Configure and assign inventory items to at least two different storage locations within the system.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully creates and associates items with the specified storage locations.
data_to_capture: List of items assigned to each storage location.

test_steps.action: Reduce the stock quantity of a specific item in one of the storage locations to below its defined minimum stock level.
test_steps.expected_result: The system accurately reflects the reduced stock quantity.
data_to_capture: Current stock quantity for the item.
Confirmation that the quantity is below the minimum threshold.

test_steps.action: Trigger the reorder alert mechanism (e.g., by running a scheduled job or manually initiating an alert check).
test_steps.expected_result: A reorder alert is generated for the item whose stock level has fallen below the minimum.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or log entry of the generated reorder alert.
Details of the alert, including item ID, current quantity, and minimum stock level.

test_steps.action: Verify that inventory can be tracked and managed independently within each configured storage location.
test_steps.expected_result: Stock movements and quantities are correctly attributed to their respective storage locations.
data_to_capture: Inventory reports filtered by storage location.
Confirmation of accurate stock levels per location.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully supports the configuration and management of inventory across multiple storage locations.
Reorder alerts are accurately generated when stock levels fall below predefined minimums.
Inventory quantities are correctly tracked and reported per storage location.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-010: Support multiple storage locations with standard location master setup.
URS-INV-011: Generate reorder alerts based on minimum stock levels using standard alerting.
data_integrity_requirements: Inventory quantities must be accurately maintained across all storage locations.
Reorder alerts must be generated based on correct minimum stock level calculations.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Inventory Audit Trail and Data Archiving
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system maintains a comprehensive audit trail for all inventory transactions and supports the archiving of transaction history according to defined retention policies.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
User has administrative privileges.
Sufficient inventory transactions have been performed to populate the audit trail.
Data retention policies are defined and configured.

test_steps.action: Perform a series of inventory transactions (e.g., receipt, issue, adjustment, transfer) for various items.
test_steps.expected_result: Each transaction is recorded in the system.
data_to_capture: Details of each transaction performed (item, quantity, type, date/time).

test_steps.action: Access and review the system's audit trail for the performed transactions.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail accurately reflects all performed transactions, including user, date/time, transaction type, and relevant details.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the audit trail entries for each transaction.
Verification of user, timestamp, and transaction details in the audit log.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archiving process based on the configured retention policies (e.g., by running a scheduled job or manually triggering archiving for old data).
test_steps.expected_result: Transaction history older than the defined retention period is successfully archived.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of the archiving process completion.
Log entries related to the archiving job.

test_steps.action: Attempt to access archived transaction data to confirm its availability and integrity (if the system supports retrieval of archived data).
test_steps.expected_result: Archived data is accessible and remains intact, or the system correctly indicates that the data is no longer in active use.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of archived data accessibility or status.
Verification of data integrity if retrieval is possible.

acceptance_criteria: The system's audit trail accurately records all inventory-related transactions with sufficient detail.
The archiving process successfully moves historical transaction data according to configured retention policies.
Archived data remains intact and accessible (if applicable) or is correctly managed as per retention rules.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-016: Maintain inventory audit trail using vendor's standard logging functionality.
URS-INV-019: Archive transaction history using vendor's data retention policies.
data_integrity_requirements: All inventory transactions must be logged in the audit trail.
Archived data must be complete and accurate.
Data retention policies must be strictly adhered to.

test_cases.test_name: Verify ERP System Integration and Data Export to Excel
test_cases.objective: To verify the system's ability to interface with the existing ERP system and export inventory data to Excel format.
prerequisites: ERP system is accessible and configured for integration.
User has necessary permissions to initiate ERP integration.
User has necessary permissions to export data to Excel.

test_steps.action: Initiate the standard connector to interface with the existing ERP system.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully establishes a connection with the ERP system, and inventory data is synchronized.
data_to_capture: Confirmation message of successful ERP connection.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the inventory reporting module and select an option to export inventory data to Excel.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an Excel file containing the current inventory data.
data_to_capture: Content of the generated Excel file.

test_steps.action: Open the exported Excel file and verify the accuracy and completeness of the inventory data against the system's real-time view.
test_steps.expected_result: The data in the Excel file accurately reflects the inventory quantities, item details, and locations as displayed in the system.
data_to_capture: Comparison of data between Excel and system.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully integrates with the ERP system.
Inventory data is accurately exported to an Excel file.
The exported Excel data matches the system's current inventory status.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-020: Interface with existing ERP system using vendor's standard connectors.
URS-INV-021: Export inventory data to Excel format using built-in export functionality.
data_integrity_requirements: Data consistency between ERP and inventory system.
Accuracy of exported data.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Inventory Accuracy Reporting and Data Retention Policies
test_cases.objective: To verify the system's capability to generate inventory accuracy reports and adhere to data retention policies for transaction history.
prerequisites: Sufficient transaction history exists to generate accuracy reports.
Data retention policies are configured in the system.
User has necessary permissions to generate reports and access audit logs.

test_steps.action: Initiate the generation of an inventory accuracy report using the system's standard reconciliation features.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an inventory accuracy report detailing discrepancies between expected and actual inventory counts.

test_steps.action: Review the generated inventory accuracy report for accuracy and completeness, comparing it against known inventory movements.
test_steps.expected_result: The report accurately reflects inventory discrepancies based on recorded transactions.

test_steps.action: Access the system's audit trail logs to confirm that transaction history is being maintained as per vendor's standard logging functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail logs contain detailed records of all inventory transactions.

test_steps.action: Verify that older transaction history has been archived according to the configured vendor's data retention policies.
test_steps.expected_result: Transaction history older than the defined retention period is no longer actively accessible but is archived.

acceptance_criteria: Inventory accuracy reports are generated accurately.
Transaction history is maintained in the audit trail.
Data retention policies are effectively applied for archiving transaction history.
regulatory_basis: URS-INV-016: Maintain inventory audit trail using vendor's standard logging functionality.
URS-INV-018: Generate inventory accuracy reports using standard reconciliation features.
URS-INV-019: Archive transaction history using vendor's data retention policies.
data_integrity_requirements: Accuracy of inventory counts.
Completeness and integrity of audit trail.
Proper archiving of historical data.
